description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git features related to case-insensitive path specifications, including committing files, matching entries, and performing diffs using special pathspec syntax.

methods.name: test_have_prereq
methods.description: Checks if a prerequisite (CASE_INSENSITIVE_FS) is satisfied before running the test.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script execution.

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a commit with specified filename and message.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case that should succeed, runs commands, and checks output.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output files.
